name: Cheese Pizza Slice with Soft Crust & Mozzarella
whyItWorks: Soft baked crust with mild tomato sauce and melted part-skim mozzarella cheese provides convenient quick-service calories without greasy pepperoni, spicy sausage, or rough vegetable toppings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dab top with a napkin to absorb extra oil. Choose plain cheese over spicy meat or pepperoni slices.
